description: Fetches one task list by id: id, title, updated, selfLink. Accepts "@default" for the user's default list — useful to resolve its real id. The list resource carries only metadata; the tasks themselves come from list_tasks.

tasklist_id.description: The task list id — from list_tasklists or create_tasklist output. "@default" addresses the user's default list.

name: get_tasklist
title: Get a task list
